summary: Frontend-only, read-only verification of the new Inbound STO Receipt page (/inventory/inbound-receipts) using the synthetic super_admin vms_session cookie. Verified page load, 11 real pending STOs rendered with all columns + Pending Receipt badge + Receive button, site filter (All/P1/P2/P8 - P1 correctly narrowed to 3 rows all routed P8->P1, back to All restored 11), row expand/collapse showing line items, Receive dialog contents (title 'Receive STO-000056', 3 qty inputs pre-filled with full requested qty of 1, unit labels, Cancel + Confirm Receipt buttons), qty edit updating state (1 -> 7.5), Cancel closing dialog. Network trace confirmed ONLY GET /api/inbound-receipts/sites and /pending fired - ZERO POST .../receive calls, so no live SAP Goods Receipt was posted. NavTabs 'Inventory Management' dropdown shows 'Inbound STO Receipt' for this user with empty allowed_pages and navigates correctly. Mobile 390px viewport also renders all 11 rows (horizontal scroll table).

ui_bugs.issue: NavTabs is rendered bare (line 97: `<NavTabs />` directly on the #F9FAFB page background) instead of inside the teal branded `<header>` wrapper every other page uses (see StockTransferPage.js line ~590-601). Result: nav tab labels use `text-white/85` on a near-white background so they are effectively invisible/unreadable (only the active 'Inventory Management' teal item is legible), and the page is missing the app logo/branding and <SapConnectionStatus />, breaking visual consistency.

React console error: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of InboundReceiptsPage.' Cause: the `orders.map()` at line 152 returns a bare fragment `<>` with keys on the inner TableRows instead of on the fragment. Fix: use `<Fragment key={order.sto_id}>` (import Fragment from react).

issues: Top nav strip effectively unreadable (white text on light grey) due to missing teal header wrapper
No app logo / page-title chip / SAP connection status indicator unlike sibling inventory pages
Table requires horizontal scroll (acceptable) but Status/Action columns are off-screen with no visual scroll affordance - user must discover the swipe to reach the Receive button

action_items: Wrap <NavTabs /> in the standard teal branded header (copy the pattern from StockTransferPage.js lines ~585-601, including SapConnectionStatus) so nav labels are readable.
Fix the React missing-key warning by keying the fragment in the orders.map (use <Fragment key={order.sto_id}>).
Optional: add a mobile scroll affordance or a card layout for the STO table below sm breakpoint.
Also unused import `WarningCircle` in InboundReceiptsPage.js (line 4) - remove.
critical_code_review_comments: InboundReceiptsPage: the initial GET /inbound-receipts/sites promise has no .catch() - a failed sites call yields an unhandled promise rejection and a silently empty filter dropdown; add error handling/toast like loadOrders has.

Confirm Receipt has no confirmation/typed acknowledgement step even though it triggers an irreversible production SAP Goods Receipt; consider a second-step confirm or disabling when qty <= 0 (currently an empty/0/negative qty input is submittable - no client-side validation on inbound-receipt-qty-input-*).
Fragment-in-map missing key (React warning) - see frontend_issues.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested read-only flows passed functionally; 2 UI/code defects found
